prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity mobile web app north-star composition, portrait 393x852
Primary request: Design the first-use Scan screen for LifeGoods, a Khmer-first packaged-food evidence guide. Composition B is scanner-led: a small Open Label mark and LifeGoods wordmark sit above an almost edge-to-edge camera field occupying the majority of the viewport. Inside the camera field, use precise Open Label corner geometry and a quiet permission message with a primary Start camera action. Below the camera is one compact search row. A fixed five-tab bottom navigation reads History, Learn, Scan, Search, Concerns, with Scan dominant at the center.
Style/medium: production-ready mobile app UI mockup, not a poster, not a phone-device frame; fast, direct, image-led consumer utility with neutral evidence discipline.
Typography: bold friendly sans with Khmer-safe generous line height; large black heading, compact secondary text.
Color palette: warm white #FAFAF7, charcoal #17181A, cool gray #6F747B and #D9DDE2, indigo #3658D4 for interaction, mango #F2B84B only for the Open Label brand and central Scan tab.
Materials: flat, crisp one-pixel rules, camera field as the dominant material, minimal elevation.
Text (verbatim): "LifeGoods", "Point at a barcode", "Camera frames are processed here and never uploaded.", "Start camera", "Search by Product or barcode", "History", "Learn", "Scan", "Search", "Concerns".
Constraints: no score, no rating, no red-to-green indicator, no positive/negative grouping, no health or purchase verdict, no recommendation, no gradients, no glass, no card grid, no phone frame, no watermark.
